rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Worksheet B is used only when Step 5, question 2 is Yes (i1040gi p. 42: self-employment, church employee or statutory employee income); the project figures its lines for every return and nothing reads them when it is not used. The credit, Worksheet A line 6 (Form 1040 line 27a), agrees.

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Where the printed steps say STOP (Steps 1 to 5) or line 4 is Yes (line 5 skipped) or line 2 is zero, the model leaves the later Worksheet A lines blank; the project computes every line regardless and applies eligibility in eic.credit, which Form 1040 line 27a reads (zero when a step stops). In an ordinary evaluation the worksheet lines are not reached on an ineligible return; where the model fills line 6 it agrees with the project, and where a step stops (for example Form 2555 at Step 1, question 3) the project's line 6 is figured but Form 1040 line 27a is zero or refused.
